answer: A durable defense is a work-bonded bridge: each agent locks a small slashable deposit before it can trade, released only after verified useful work. Fake identities then face a real cost, like crossing an ocean one toll at a time — a sybil flood must pay for every crossing. The sable public ledger records each agent's history, so a fresh identity with no track record earns no trust and no premium work until it proves itself.
